issues.explanation: The creating callback unconditionally overwrites code, so an explicit factory code such as Q123 would be replaced instead of kept as task requirement 5 demands.
Canonical-form key check uses (string)$priority but PHP casts numeric-string array keys like 010 to int 10 before validation, so the 010 rejection cannot trigger.

review.summary: The change implements daily per-prefix sequencing, custom prefix maps, single-clock issuance and docs with thorough Pest coverage. It needs changes before merging because the factory callback as shown overwrites explicit codes, plus a minor PHP key-casting limit on the 010 canonical check.
